lines.en: Awoken by the sound of my phone, I fight back against the desire to keep my eyes closed and continue my dream.
lines.zh: 被手机铃声吵醒,我挣扎着对抗继续闭眼、沉回梦中的欲望。

lines.en: You see, as “wonderful” as those have been lately, I’ve developed a bit of an issue when it comes to staying trapped inside of them for too long.
lines.zh: 要知道,尽管那些梦最近「美妙」至极,在里面困得太久,已经让我生出了一个毛病。

lines.en: And what I mean by this is rather personal — but seeing as you’ve watched me penetrate countless teens by now, I suppose that you knowing one more intimate detail isn’t the end of the world.
lines.zh: 这话的意思相当私人——不过既然你都已看过我进入无数少女的身体,再多知道一个私密细节,大概也算不上天塌。

lines.en: You see, I’ve become so invested and immersed in my dreams lately, that I’ve been cumming in my sleep.
lines.zh: 你看,我最近对梦境投入、沉浸到,我会在睡梦中去了。

lines.en: It’s particularly obnoxious on nights where it happens early on as it gives the cum time to dry and creates an extremely unpleasant sensation that never ceases to shock and surprise me.
lines.zh: 尤其烦人的是发生得早的夜晚——精液有时间变干,制造出一种极其不适的感觉,总令我惊愕不已。

lines.en: But I suck it up (not literally of course) because the things I’ve been experiencing in the world where she exists are far better than anything I’ve experienced here.
lines.zh: 但我忍了下来(当然不是字面意义),因为在她存在的那个世界里,我体验的一切远比这边任何东西都好。

lines.en: I had sex with the God of Torment last night.
lines.zh: 昨晚,我和折磨之神做了爱。

lines.en: And the reason I’ve decided to wake up is not just because I wanted to save myself a morning-shower, but because I feared for my dream-penis and what her scissor wings would do to it.
lines.zh: 而我决定醒来的原因,不只是省掉一次晨间淋浴,而是我担心我的梦中肉棒,和她那双剪刀之翼会对它做什么。

lines.en: : Hello?
: Oh! Good morning, Akira. I’m not calling too early, am I?
lines.zh: : 哦!早上好,Akira。我打得太早了吧?

lines.en: : Why are you calling at all?
lines.zh: : 你为什么要打?

lines.en: : Oh my. Judging by that attitude, perhaps it is too early after all. Would you prefer if I called back at a later time?
lines.zh: : 哎呀。听这口气,或许确实太早了。要我稍后再打吗?

lines.en: : I didn’t mean to give you an attitude. I’m just not sure why you couldn’t wait until-
lines.zh: : 我不是故意摆态度。我只是不明白你怎么不能等到——

lines.en: I take a look at the clock to find it’s even earlier than I thought.
lines.zh: 我看了一眼时钟,发现比我想的还早。

lines.en: : Tsubasa, it’s only 6:30.
lines.zh: : Tsubasa,才六点半。

lines.en: : Well, what time do people in your tax bracket typically get themselves out of bed?
lines.zh: : 嗯,那你这个税阶的人通常几点起床?

lines.en: : Any day where I have to get out of bed before 7:00 winds up being terrible. But hey, every day has been terrible lately. So I guess I’ll just...go get the worm or something.
lines.zh: : 凡是七点前必须起床的日子,最后都会很糟。不过嘿,最近天天都很糟。那我大概就……去抓那条虫什么的吧。

lines.en: : The worm?
: You know...like...the early bird gets the worm.
lines.zh: : 你知道……就是……早起的鸟儿有虫吃。

lines.en: : I’m confused. You own a bird?
lines.zh: : 我糊涂了。你养鸟了?

lines.en: : Never mind. Just tell me what you want.
lines.zh: : 算了。你就直说我有什么事。

lines.en: : What kind of bird is it?
lines.zh: : 那是什么鸟?

lines.en: : Tsubasa, I don’t have a bird.
lines.zh: : Tsubasa,我没有鸟。

lines.en: : Why, it’s very impolite to trick people over the phone, Akira. You should know by now how gullible and easy to deceive I am.
lines.zh: : 哎呀,在电话里捉弄人很没礼貌的,Akira。你应该早就知道我有多轻信、多好骗。

lines.en: : You? No. Touka, maybe. But I refuse to believe you’re not aware of everything ever at all times.
lines.zh: : 你?不会。Touka 倒有可能。但我不信你会不是时时刻刻知晓一切。

lines.en: : Hahah! Stop, stop. You give me too much credit, Akira.
lines.zh: : 哈哈!停停停。你太抬举我了,Akira。

lines.en: : Why do you keep saying my name?
lines.zh: : 你为什么一直念我的名字?

lines.en: : Well, because it’s a beautiful name, of course! Akira. I’m sure you don’t mind me using your given name, correct? We are friends after all, aren’t we?
lines.zh: : 嗯,因为那是个美丽的名字,当然!Akira。我相信你不介意我直呼你的名,对吧?我们毕竟是朋友,不是吗?

lines.en: : Is that what we are?
lines.zh: : 我们是那种关系?

lines.en: : I believe so. Unless you’re looking to get something else out of this relationship.
lines.zh: : 我认为是。除非你想从这段关系里得到别的什么。

lines.en: : Sorry, are you flirting with me right now? Is this a booty call?
lines.zh: : 抱歉,你现在是在撩我吗?这是约炮电话?

lines.en: : Oh, I’ve heard of those in pop culture! That’s when two people arrange a meet-up with the intention of having sexual intercourse, correct?
lines.zh: : 哦,流行文化里我听说过!就是两个人约出来、以性交为目的,对吧?

lines.en: : Uhh...yeah. Yeah, that’s what that means.
lines.zh: : 呃……对。对,就是这个意思。

lines.en: : Hilarious! But no, that’s not what this is. And I can’t quite tell if I’m flattered or offended that you’d assume such a thing.
lines.zh: : 太好笑了!但不,这不是那个。你会有这种猜测,我还分不清该觉得受宠还是被冒犯。

lines.en: : I would like to see you, though.
lines.zh: : 不过,我确实想见你。

lines.en: : For purposes unrelated to sex as I’m a faithful  albeit extremely unsatisfied
lines.zh: : 出于与性无关的目的——毕竟我是个忠贞的、尽管极其不满足的

lines.en: : You got quiet in the middle of that last-
lines.zh: : 你刚才说到一半突然没——

lines.en: : I’m afraid I don’t know what you’re talking about. Regardless, are you free right now? I’ve opened up a slot in anticipation of your arrival.
lines.zh: : 恐怕我不明白你在说什么。无论如何,你现在有空吗?我为你的到来预留了一个时段。

lines.en: : Now? I have to check on my niece first.
lines.zh: : 现在?我得先去看看我侄女。

lines.en: : Ahh...yes. I’ve heard from Touka that things seem rather...complicated in that regard. But don’t worry. You may take your time.
lines.zh: : 啊……对。听 Touka 说,那方面的事态似乎相当……复杂。但别担心。你可以慢慢来。

lines.en: : And whenever you’re ready, there will be a car outside of your house.
lines.zh: : 而且无论你何时准备好,你家门外都会停着一辆车。

lines.en: : Like...Like it’s there right now?
lines.zh: : 像……像它现在就停在那?

lines.en: : Yes. But it’s fine to keep them waiting. They’re very well-trained and understand that commoners don’t prioritize punctuality the way my family does.
lines.zh: : 是。但让它等着无妨。它们训练有素,明白平民不像我们家那样看重守时。

lines.en: : Tsubasa, I didn’t even know we were meeting until a few minutes ago. I don’t think punctuality matters here.
lines.zh: : Tsubasa,几分钟前我都不知道我们要见面。这里谈不上什么守时。

lines.en: : Akira, while I do love the sound of your voice, I do hope you know that every second you spend talking to me is one second between you and your beloved Ami. And then subsequently me again.
lines.zh: : Akira,虽然我很爱你的声音,但我希望你明白,你和我多说的每一秒,都是你和你挚爱的 Ami 之间的一秒。然后,接着又是和我的一秒。

lines.en: : Can I at least know what you want to talk about so I can prime myself for another uncomfortable discussion with a woman who could have me killed at any moment?
lines.zh: : 我至少能知道你要谈什么吧,好让我先做好心理准备,迎接又一场和不舒服的女人进行的不舒服对话?她随时能让人弄死我。

lines.en: : Hahah! No, actually. I quite like the idea of keeping you on edge.
lines.zh: : 哈哈!不,其实不告诉你。我很喜欢让你提心吊胆这个主意。

lines.en: : Tsubasa-
lines.zh: : Tsubasa——

lines.en: : Ciao!
lines.zh: : Ciao!

lines.en: I hang up the phone and...accept that this is happening again.
lines.zh: 我挂了电话,然后……接受了这一切又发生了。

lines.en: But even though Tsubasa’s affinity for keeping me on my toes is shining brighter than ever, I do have to note that she hasn’t yet blinded me in any capacity. So maybe this...instinctual distrust is wrong.
lines.zh: 不过,尽管 Tsubasa 让我时刻紧绷的癖好比以往任何时候都闪亮,我必须指出,她还没有在任何意义上晃瞎我的眼。所以也许这种……本能的不信任是错的。

lines.en: She is on my side, right?
lines.zh: 她是站在我这边的,对吧?

lines.en: And if she trusts me enough to be alone with her daughters, then-
lines.zh: 而如果她足够信任我、愿意让我和她的女儿们独处,那么——

lines.en: THEN SHE IS A FOOLISH BITCH IN NEED OF SOME THICK COCK.
lines.zh: 那她就是个需要粗壮肉棒的愚蠢贱货。

lines.en: : Thank you very much for coming, Akira. Please allow me to extend my sincerest apologies in regard to tearing you away from your niece.
lines.zh: : 非常感谢你能来,Akira。请容我真诚致歉——把你从你侄女身边扯开了。

lines.en: : It’s fine. She can be alone for a little while.
lines.zh: : 没关系。她可以一个人待一会儿。

lines.en: : Forgive me for asking, but would you mind sharing exactly what’s wrong with her? Because, if there’s something I could do-
lines.zh: : 恕我冒昧,介意说说她到底怎么了?因为,如果有什么我能帮上——

lines.en: : Can you bring the dead back to life?
lines.zh: : 你能让死人复活吗?

lines.en: : That was a joke.
lines.zh: : 那是个玩笑。

lines.en: : Oh, good. I couldn’t quite tell.
lines.zh: : 哦,好。我差点没看出来。

lines.en: : Yeah. But Tsubasa, before you talk about whatever you’re going to talk about, I want to make something extremely clear to you.
lines.zh: : 是。但 Tsubasa,在你谈你打算谈的事之前,我要先把一件事跟你讲得极其清楚。

lines.en: : Please do.
lines.zh: : 请讲。

lines.en: : Do not, under any circumstances, get yourself involved with my niece.
lines.zh: : 无论如何,不许你和我侄女扯上关系。

lines.en: : I get that you’re a curious woman who wants to use her powers for good or whatever it was that pushed you into uprooting Chika’s entire life and planting your daughter in my class.
lines.zh: : 我明白你是个好奇心旺盛的女人,想把你的力量用在正道上,或者不管是什么——让你连根拔起 Chika 的整个人生、把你女儿塞进我班的东西。

lines.en: : But this is different. This is my family. And I will not let you get involved with Ami.
lines.zh: : 但这次不一样。这是我的家人。我不会让你和 Ami 扯上关系。

lines.en: : Forgive me for being blunt here- but who do you think you are, speaking to me that way?
lines.zh: : 恕我直言——你算老几,敢用那种口气对我说话?

lines.en: : I’m not kidding. This-
lines.zh: : 我没开玩笑。这——

lines.en: : Hahah! Forgive me! I just couldn’t help but try to sound threatening there.
lines.zh: : 哈哈!原谅我!我只是忍不住想摆一摆威胁的架子。

lines.en: : I can assure you that if you do not want me to get involved, that I will keep my nose out of it. I know a thing or two about the situation and can acknowledge how sticky it must be.
lines.zh: : 我向你保证,只要你不想让我掺和,我就绝不插手。关于那个处境,我知道一些事,也承认它一定非常棘手。

lines.en: : I’m...not surprised to hear you know “a thing or two.” But...thanks.
lines.zh: : 听到你知道「一些事」,我……并不意外。不过……谢谢。

lines.en: : Were you scared, though? Of my “don’t talk to me like that” voice? Did I sound intimidating?
lines.zh: : 但你当时怕了吗?怕我那句「不许那样跟我说话」的嗓音?我听起来吓人吗?

lines.en: : You pretty much always sound intimidating.
lines.zh: : 你基本上随时都吓人。

lines.en: : How was I, though? I don’t get all serious that often so I have no idea how it must have sounded.
lines.zh: : 可那一次怎么样?我不常那么严肃,所以完全不知道听起来如何。

lines.en: : I quite liked it, actually. It isn’t every day that someone speaks to me like that.
lines.zh: : 其实我挺喜欢的。可不是每天都有人那样跟我讲话。

lines.en: : But I suppose our time would be better spent discussing matters apart from the things we like about one another. After all, you never know when my husband might be listening in.
lines.zh: : 但我想,我们的时间更应该用来谈些别的,而不是互诉喜欢。毕竟,谁知道我丈夫什么时候在偷听。

lines.en: : And I can’t imagine he’s the type of person you want to make jealous. Right, Akira?
lines.zh: : 而我无法想象,他是你愿意去招惹嫉妒的类型。对吧,Akira?

lines.en: : The reason I called you is simple, really. And it’s a call you’d be right to expect at...somewhat regular intervals in the future.
lines.zh: : 我打给你的原因其实很简单。而且在将来……以一定间隔,你完全可以预期还会接到这样的电话。

lines.en: : I understand that you’ve decided to take a leave of absence from your job as a teacher, correct?
lines.zh: : 我了解到,你已决定从教师的职位上休假,对吧?

lines.en: : Yeah, but...if this is about me going back-
lines.zh: : 对,但如果这是要我回去——

lines.en: : It’s nothing of the sort. I’d never force you to do anything, even if it does seem as if I’m pushing you in certain directions from time to time.
lines.zh: : 完全不是。我绝不会强迫你做任何事,哪怕我看起来时不时在把你往某些方向推。

lines.en: : I know. Because you’re the type who will manipulate me into thinking that I’m making my own decisions instead. When, in all actuality, you’re the one pulling my strings.
lines.zh: : 我知道。因为你是那种会操纵我、让我以为一切出于自决的人。而实际上,牵线的人是你。

lines.en: : Ooooh...you’re feisty today.
lines.zh: : 哦————你今天火力挺足。

lines.en: : Only because I know you like being talked down to now.
lines.zh: : 只因为我知道你现在喜欢被人居高临下地说话。

lines.en: : Don’t push it, though. You’re not quite sure what my limits are yet, Akira.
lines.zh: : 但别蹬鼻子上脸。你还不太清楚我的底线在哪,Akira。

lines.en: : You’re right. So please, do me the favor of telling me what you’re going to manipulate me into doing this time so I can go back home and take a nap.
lines.zh: : 你说得对。所以行行好,告诉我这次你要操纵我干什么,我好回家睡个回笼觉。

lines.en: : Status reports.
lines.zh: : 状态汇报。

lines.en: : Status reports?
lines.zh: : 状态汇报?

lines.en: : On all four of my daughters since the Chosokabe girls are under my wing now as well.
lines.zh: : 对我四个女儿——毕竟 Chosokabe 家的女孩们如今也归我照看了。

lines.en: : Can’t you just...ask them yourself? There’s no sense in hearing about their education from me when A) I’m no longer a teacher. And B) I could just lie and make myself sound better than I actually am.
lines.zh: : 你不能……自己问她们吗?从我嘴里听她们的教育毫无意义——一,我已经不是老师了。二,我完全可以撒谎,把自己说得比实际高尚。

lines.en: : It’s not their education I’m interested in, Akira. I can evaluate that myself. And frankly, I imagine I’m more adept at such a thing than you to begin with.
lines.zh: : 我感兴趣的不是她们的教育,Akira。那个我自己就能评估。而且坦白说,我猜在这方面我本来就比你在行。

lines.en: : What I want is your opinion on the type of women they’re becoming. If they’re sticking to the right path or-
lines.zh: : 我要的是,你对她们正在成为怎样的女人的看法。她们是否守在正确的道路上,还是——

lines.en: : If they’re following me down the one I’m on...
lines.zh: : 还是她们正跟着我,走在我走的这条路上……

lines.en: : Now, now, Akira. There’s no need to belittle yourself like that.
lines.zh: : 好了好了,Akira。没必要这样贬低自己。

lines.en: : I’m just not sure what else you could mean. Without beating around the bush, we both know you’re smart enough to realize that nothing good will come from any of them being around me.
lines.zh: : 我只是不确定你还能指什么。恕我直言,我们都清楚你聪明得很,明白她们任何一个待在我身边,都不会有好结果。

lines.en: : Again, you seem to misunderstand the way I view your relationships with all of my girls. So I’ll remind you now that my moral code is somewhat askew as well due to my background.
lines.zh: : 再说一遍,你似乎误解了我看待你和我所有女孩之间关系的方式。所以我现在提醒你:由于我的出身,我的道德准则也同样有些歪斜。

lines.en: : Is this the part where you slap a bell around your daughter’s neck and see how much I’m willing to bid for her?
lines.zh: : 是不是接下来,你要给你女儿脖子上挂个铃铛,看看我愿意出多少钱竞拍她?

lines.en: : The wealthiest among us are typically the most frugal, Akira. As such, there’s no need for a bell at all. Touka’s already grazing in your pasture and you’ll always be able to find her there if you just step outside.
lines.zh: : 我们之中最有钱的人,通常也最节俭,Akira。因此,铃铛根本用不着。Touka 已经在你的牧场上吃草了,只要你走出家门,永远都能在那里找到她。

lines.en: : I’m...out of cow-based knowledge and unsure of how to proceed with this dialogue.
lines.zh: : 我的……母牛知识储备告罄,不知道这段对话要怎么进行下去。

lines.en: : Then I’ll ask you plain and simple.
lines.zh: : 那我就简单地问。

lines.en: Tsubasa moves further down an aisle lined with marble and satin and emphasizes the distance between us in every sense of the word.
lines.zh: Tsubasa 沿着一条铺满大理石与绸缎的走道走得更远,用「距离」这个词的每一种含义,强调着我们之间的距离。

lines.en: And even though I know I’ll never catch her, I can’t help but chase her down.
lines.zh: 尽管我知道自己永远追不上她,我还是忍不住追了上去。

lines.en: She turns to face me. And despite her inarguable beauty and the passing thought that simply touching her would be akin to fucking the God of Torment once more, I feel stuck.
lines.zh: 她转过身面对我。尽管她美得无可辩驳,尽管脑中闪过「碰她一下就等于再一次和折磨之神做爱」的念头,我却僵在原地。

lines.en: I want to reach out and feel her, but I’m content with the space between us and the way the sunlight reflects off of the manor’s tiled floors. And I don’t want to ruin it.
lines.zh: 我想伸手触碰她,可我满足于我们之间的这段距离,满足于阳光洒在公馆瓷砖地板上的样子。而我不想毁掉它。

lines.en: I want to stay here forever, dangling from the strings she holds above my head because I know she can choose better for me than I ever could.
lines.zh: 我想永远留在这里,悬在她举在我头顶的提线上——因为我知道,她能替我做的选择,永远比我自己的更好。

lines.en: I’ll just never understand why my strings were the ones she reached for.
lines.zh: 我只是永远不明白,她伸手的为什么偏偏是我的提线。

lines.en: : Touka’s seemed a bit...different lately. Would you agree with that, Akira?
lines.zh: : Touka 最近似乎有点……不一样。你同意吗,Akira?

lines.en: : I...haven’t seen her much. I’ve been unconscious for two months, remember?
lines.zh: : 我……没怎么见过她。我昏迷了两个月,记得吗?

lines.en: : Right, right. And, within that time, she grew rather...grumpy, to say the least. Why, she’s even raised her voice at me a few times. It was quite shocking.
lines.zh: : 对,对。而在那段时间里,她变得相当……乖戾,姑且这么说。哎呀,她甚至冲我提过几次嗓门。相当震惊。

lines.en: : Where do you think that attitude comes from, Akira?
lines.zh: : 你觉得那种态度是从哪来的,Akira?

lines.en: : My eldest daughter truly has fallen head over heels for you, hasn't she?
lines.zh: : 我的大女儿是真的为你神魂颠倒了,不是吗?

lines.en: : Nothing’s happened between us, Tsubasa.
lines.zh: : 我们之间什么都没发生,Tsubasa。

lines.en: : Yes, but is that your choosing or hers?
lines.zh: : 是,可那是你的选择,还是她的?

lines.en: : I don’t...see her that way.
lines.zh: : 我没有……那样看她。

lines.en: : Nonsense. Every man in Kumon-mi would jump at the chance to bed my daughter regardless of her age. Denying your own feelings on the matter would actually be quite offensive.
lines.zh: : 胡说。Kumon-mi 的所有男人都会抢着和我女儿上床,无论她多大年纪。否认你在这件事上的真实感受,反而相当失礼。

lines.en: : I mean...yeah. She’s hot. But I’ve found...something else in her.
lines.zh: : 就是说……对,她很辣。但我在她身上……发现了别的东西。

lines.en: : Something else?
lines.zh: : 别的东西?

lines.en: : Something...I don’t know. It’s going to sound stupid.
lines.zh: : 某种……我不知道。说出来会很蠢。

lines.en: : No, I’m intrigued. Do tell.
lines.zh: : 不,我很好奇。讲吧。

lines.en: : Something...comforting.
lines.zh: : 某种……令人安心的东西。

lines.en: : Comforting...
lines.zh: : 令人安心……

lines.en: : As in...matriarchal?
lines.zh: : 就像……母性的?

lines.en: : Yeah...That.
lines.zh: : 对……就是那个。

lines.en: : Hah...I see.
lines.zh: : 哈……我懂了。

lines.en: : Does that...disappoint you?
lines.zh: : 那会……让你失望吗?

lines.en: : It doesn’t disappoint me. And I can understand where you’re coming from. I’m just surprised to see a man your age admit it. Isn’t your type typically a bit more...proud?
lines.zh: : 不会让我失望。我也能理解你的来处。我只是惊讶,你这个年纪的男人居然肯承认。你们这种人的取向,通常不是更……骄傲一点吗?

lines.en: : Probably. But I’ve reached a point where everything hurts so much that I find little purpose in continuing to hide feelings like that.
lines.zh: : 大概。但我已经走到了这一步——一切痛得要命,继续隐藏那种感情,我觉得没什么意义了。

lines.en: : How do you think Touka would feel if she heard you say such a thing?
lines.zh: : 你觉得,要是 Touka 听到你说这种话,会作何感受?

lines.en: : Sad. Angry. Compassionate? I don’t know. Touka’s a lot of things and literally all of them are good.
lines.zh: : 难过。愤怒。同情?我不知道。Touka 有很多面,而 literal 上每一面都是好的。

lines.en: : And Tsukasa?
lines.zh: : 那 Tsukasa 呢?

lines.en: : What about her?
lines.zh: : 她怎么了?

lines.en: : You had your first session with her the other day, didn’t you? Tutoring.
lines.zh: : 前几天,你和她的第一次课已经上过了,对吧?辅导。

lines.en: : Not intentionally. She kind of just showed up and then everything went to shit.
lines.zh: : 并非有意为之。她就那么出现了,然后一切都糟透了。

lines.en: : Hah...I was worried about that.
lines.zh: : 哈……我就担心这个。

lines.en: : In fact, I didn’t even know you two had run into one another until Chika informed me. And when I confronted Tsukasa about it, she was unwilling to say anything at all. Likely out of shame, I imagine.
lines.zh: : 实际上,直到 Chika 告诉我,我都不知道你们俩碰过面。而我去质问 Tsukasa 时,她什么都不肯说。多半是羞于启齿吧,我猜。

lines.en: : No, Tsukasa didn’t do anything wrong. I was just...not in the right frame of mind that day. It wasn’t her fault.
lines.zh: : 不,Tsukasa 没做错任何事。只是那天我……精神状态不对。不是她的错。

lines.en: : Is...Is that so? You’re not just saying that to keep her out of trouble?
lines.zh: : 是……是吗?你不是为了让她脱身才这么说的?

lines.en: : No. Tsukasa...
lines.zh: : 不是。Tsukasa……

lines.en: : Forgive me for saying this, but Tsukasa’s a brat.
lines.zh: : 恕我直言,Tsukasa 是个小浑蛋。

lines.en: : Oh, I’m well aware.
lines.zh: : 哦,我心里有数。

lines.en: : But she’s very smart. And I can tell she’s been raised well.
lines.zh: : 但她非常聪明。而且看得出她家教很好。

lines.en: : And if I was in the position to be tutoring again, she’d be great. She seems willing to learn and...and easy to teach so long as she doesn’t fire me for looking at her wrong.
lines.zh: : 如果我还有资格做辅导,她会很出色。她看起来愿意学,而且……只要她不因为我多看一眼就开除我,教起来很容易。

lines.en: : And the reason you’re not in the “position” to tutor is because of your...mental health?
lines.zh: : 而你之所以不在「资格」上,是因为你的……精神健康?

lines.en: : Right.
: As in...you believe it would be dangerous for my daughter to be in your care? Or you believe you would be in danger due to caring for my daughter?
lines.zh: : 就是说……你认为我的女儿交给你照管会有危险?还是你认为,照管我的女儿,你自己会陷入危险?

lines.en: : Both?...
: I see.
lines.zh: : 我懂了。

lines.en: : I must have scared you when we first spoke about this in my office.
lines.zh: : 第一次在我书房谈这件事时,我一定吓到你了。

lines.en: : Yeah, well...
lines.zh: : 嗯,这个嘛……

lines.en: : Not as much as I scare myself sometimes.
lines.zh: : 没有我有时吓我自己那么厉害。

lines.en: : Are...you thinking about something?
lines.zh: : 你……在想什么?

lines.en: : A few things. But each one seems rather...destructive?
lines.zh: : 一些事。但每一件看起来都相当……毁灭性?

lines.en: : That’s...not a good word.
lines.zh: : 那……不是个好词。

lines.en: : The gist is that I’m not sure how I’m supposed to look at you now.
lines.zh: : 大意是,我不知道现在该怎么看你。

lines.en: : Meaning?
lines.zh: : 什么意思?

lines.en: : Meaning that it sounds rather fishy to hear you talk about not wanting to bed my eldest daughter, but not trusting yourself around my youngest.
lines.zh: : 意思是,听你嘴上说着不想和我大女儿上床,却又不敢和我小女儿独处,这听起来相当可疑。

lines.en: : Can we just...not talk about this anymore?
lines.zh: : 我们能不能……别再聊这个了?

lines.en: : I think we have to now, don’t we?
lines.zh: : 我觉得现在必须聊,不是吗?

lines.en: : We definitely don’t. And I should probably head home before-
lines.zh: : 我们真的不必。而且我大概该在——之前回家——

lines.en: : Akira.
lines.zh: : Akira。

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 什么?

lines.en: : Oh, nothing.
lines.zh: : 哦,没什么。

lines.en: : I just wanted to say your name again.
lines.zh: : 我只是想再念一遍你的名字。

lines.en: : Akira, Akira, Akira...What an interesting man you are.
lines.zh: : Akira,Akira,Akira……你真是个有意思的男人。

lines.en: : I wonder how you got here? Apart from the limo, I mean.
lines.zh: : 我好奇你是怎么走到今天的?我是说,除了那辆豪华轿车之外。

lines.en: : It’s probably better if we avoid that topic too.
lines.zh: : 那个话题大概也避之为妙。

lines.en: : Oh?
: It’s just...bringing up the past isn’t exactly one of my fondest hobbies. And it doesn’t help that most of it is still pretty hazy.
lines.zh: : 只是……翻旧账算不上我最爱的爱好。而且大部分往事,至今仍相当模糊,这也无济于事。

lines.en: : Yes...age will do that to us, won’t it?
lines.zh: : 是啊……岁月就会这样对待我们,不是吗?

lines.en: : And misery.
lines.zh: : 还有苦难。

lines.en: : Are you unhappy, Akira?
lines.zh: : 你不幸福吗,Akira?

lines.en: : I don’t know how much longer I can do this, Tsubasa.
lines.zh: : 我不知道自己还能这样撑多久,Tsubasa。

lines.en: : Mm.
: I’m glad you’re happy, though. You have an amazing life and two amazing daughters.
lines.zh: : 不过我很高兴你幸福。你的人生很精彩,还有两个很棒的女儿。

lines.en: : Do you think having such things is enough to make a person happy?
lines.zh: : 你觉得,拥有这些东西就足以让一个人幸福吗?

lines.en: : Is it not?
lines.zh: : 不足以吗?

lines.en: : Sometimes I wonder.
lines.zh: : 有时我也在想。

lines.en: : It takes more than just having things to make life worth living. But I guess we can leave it at that as I don’t want to make you feel any worse than I’m sure you already do.
lines.zh: : 光是「拥有」,并不足以让人生值得活下去。不过我想我们就聊到这里——我不想让你比我确信的、已经糟糕的心情更糟。

lines.en: : Then...I guess this concludes our status report?
lines.zh: : 那么……我猜我们的状态汇报到此结束?

lines.en: : I guess so.
lines.zh: : 我想是吧。

lines.en: : Please hand me your cell phone.
lines.zh: : 请把你的手机交给我。

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 什么?

lines.en: : Immediately.
lines.zh: : 立刻。

lines.en: : Or I will have it seized by security.
lines.zh: : 否则我会让保安没收它。

lines.en: : I don’t-
lines.zh: : 我不——

lines.en: : Now, please.
lines.zh: : 现在,请。

lines.en: : I don’t have all day.
lines.zh: : 我没那么多时间。

lines.en: : Tsubasa-
lines.zh: : Tsubasa——

lines.en: : Yoink.
lines.zh: : 嗖——归我了。

lines.en: : What?...
: Why are you-
lines.zh: : 你要干——

lines.en: : Shh...
: Everything will be over soon.
lines.zh: : 一切很快就都会结束的。

lines.en: : Oooh. Cute wallpaper.
lines.zh: : 哦噢。壁纸很可爱。

lines.en: : You must really love your niece.
lines.zh: : 你一定非常爱你的侄女。

lines.en: : What are you doing?...
lines.zh: : 你在干什么?……

lines.en: : Calling the police, of course.
lines.zh: : 当然是报警。

lines.en: : I left my phone in the other room. And you’ve said some very suspicious things in regard to my darling Tsukasa that I’m not willing to ignore.
lines.zh: : 我把手机落在另一个房间了。而关于我亲爱的 Tsukasa,你说了几句非常可疑的话,我不打算视而不见。

lines.en: : But...nothing’s happened...
lines.zh: : 可是……什么都没发生过……

lines.en: : Then you won’t mind your house being searched.
lines.zh: : 那你不会介意你的房子被搜查吧。

lines.en: : Tsubasa-
lines.zh: : Tsubasa——

lines.en: : I’m kidding.
lines.zh: : 我开玩笑的。

lines.en: : Here.
Tsubasa hands the phone back to me and-
lines.zh: Tsubasa 把手机递还给我,然后——

lines.en: You have obtained Tsukasa’s phone number!
lines.zh: 你获得了 Tsukasa 的电话号码!
: 为什么?……

lines.en: : Who knows? Maybe I’m a bad person after all?
lines.zh: : 谁知道呢?说不定我终究是个坏人?

lines.en: : What’s wrong? Cat got your tongue?
lines.zh: : 怎么了?舌头被猫叼走了?

lines.en: : I just...I’m so confused...
lines.zh: : 我只是……我好乱……

lines.en: : Me too. We’ll see if I regret this later.
lines.zh: : 我也是。以后再看我会不会后悔。

lines.en: : I read in a self-help book recently that doing impulsive things like this can lead to an increase in serotonin. Maybe this was a bit too impulsive, though?
lines.zh: : 我最近在一本自助书里读到,这种冲动行事能提高血清素。不过,这次也许冲动得有点过头了?

lines.en: : You think?
lines.zh: : 你觉得呢?

lines.en: : Well, look at it this way — you’ve been hanging around Chinami for how long now? And you’ve never done anything impure to her, have you?
lines.zh: : 嗯,这样看吧——你和 Chinami 厮混多久了?而你对她的所作所为,有没有一件不纯的?

lines.en: : Well...no. But-
lines.zh: : 嗯……没有。但是——

lines.en: : Then there’s clearly a part of you that knows how wrong it is and that part of you is winning. Just look at this as a...test.
lines.zh: : 那么显然,你身上有一部分知道那有多错,而那部分正在赢。就把它看作一场……测试吧。

lines.en: : This isn’t a test I want to take, Tsubasa.
lines.zh: : 这不是我想参加的测试,Tsubasa。

lines.en: : We all have to do things we don’t want sometimes, Akira.
lines.zh: : 我们有时候都得做自己不想做的事,Akira。

lines.en: : You don’t. Touka doesn’t. Tsukasa doesn’t.
lines.zh: : 你不用。Touka 不用。Tsukasa 不用。

lines.en: : All I’m hearing is that your life would be smooth sailing if you married one of my daughters and joined the family. And look, I’ve now made it easier than ever for you to do that.
lines.zh: : 我听到的意思只有:如果你娶我任何一个女儿、加入这个家族,你的人生就会一帆风顺。你看,我已经让你比以往任何时候都更容易做到了。

lines.en: : You’re putting way too much trust in me.
lines.zh: : 你对我寄托了太多信任。

lines.en: : Who says I’m putting any trust in you at all? Maybe I’m just...cutting off a few of your strings so you don’t confuse yourself as my puppet anymore.
lines.zh: : 谁说我对你寄托了任何信任?说不定我只是……剪断你的几根提线,免得你继续把自己错当成我的傀儡。

lines.en: : Aaaaanyway, I need to review some recent acquisitions before a call this afternoon. But you’re free to continue exploring the grounds if you like.
lines.zh: : Anyway————我下午有个电话,得先审几份最近的收购案。不过你要是愿意,可以继续在场地里随便逛。

lines.en: : There’s a good chance you might find Touka in the pool. But I’m worried her poor, maidenly heart wouldn’t be able to take another instance of her beloved Sensei seeing her as a matriarch.
lines.zh: : 你很有可能会在泳池边撞见 Touka。但我担心她那颗可怜的少女之心,承受不了挚爱的 Sensei 再一次把她看作女家主。

lines.en: : Until next time, Akira.
lines.zh: : 下次再会,Akira。

lines.en: : I’m hoping for a very interesting status report.
lines.zh: : 我期待一份非常有趣的状态汇报。

lines.en: I leave the manor.
lines.zh: 我离开了公馆。

lines.en: I turn my phone off.
lines.zh: 我关掉了手机。

lines.en: Tsubasa’s affection has increased to [tsubasa_love]!
lines.zh: Tsubasa 的好感度提升到了 [tsubasa_love]!
